basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast who recently got into customizing Android devices. Based in Eastern Europe, I work as a junior software developer. When I'm not coding, I'm either learning about new tech trends or gaming. I'm single and usually online late at night after work. I prefer cool climates and enjoy exploring open-source projects.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught in technology through online resources and forums. I have a basic understanding of Android development and rooting, mostly from experimenting with my own devices. I often consult tech forums and YouTube tutorials.
